full_judgment: 3. The course of MS Urology of Dhaka Medical College is affiliated to the said University by order dated 28-7-99 giving an effect from July 1999 session (Annexure-B). The University issued a notification under Memo No. BSMMU/CS Jan/2000/3705 dated 28-9-99 published in the daily newspaper, Janakantha, on 30-9-1999 inviting applications from the candidates including the candidates who are in government service. The age limit for the government candidates for the admission in the post graduate course was fixed at 40 years as on 31-12-99 (Annexure-C and C-1). Subsequently, the University published another amended notification dated 4-11-99 published in the said newspaper on 5-11-99 which increased the age limit of the Government candidate from 40 to 45 years for this year only (Annexure-D and D-1). The Medical Education Division, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare. Government of Bangladesh, in its recent deputation policy circulated by memo dated 3-2-98 (Annexure-E) for Post Graduate Education of the BCS (Health) cadres has also fixed age limit up to 45 years. The other affiliated colleges and institutes including Non-Government Institutions vide Annexure-F series also issued notice inviting application for admission in the post graduate course fixing the age limit for the government candidate up to 45 years complying with the aforesaid government policy. The Dhaka Medical College published notice Annexure-G dated 7-10-99 inviting application for admission in various courses including MS Urology by fixing 40 years age limit for the government candidate following the previous notification of the University 28-9-1999 (Annexure-C). After publication of the notification dated 5-11-99 (Annexure-D) by the University the petitioner, in order to avail the last chance for obtaining decree of MS (Urology) from Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujib Medical University under the Dhaka Medical College, obtained the admission form on payment of requisite fees and submitted it after up filling with required documents on the same day on 14-11-99, and the petitioner was expecting to get admit card for appearing at the, admission test. The petitioner, without getting admit card on 21-11-99, the date of admission test, made an inquiry in the office of the Principal and his department in the Dhaka Medical College and came to know that Professor Dr SAM Golam Kibria, Head of the Department of Urology (respondent No. 2) made an endorsement in the petitioner's admission form "over age not eligible" (Annexure- H) and as such, his form was not processed, The age of the petitioner will be 42 years 4 months 25 days on 31-12-1999 and this is the date to be counted and he is quite eligible for admission according to the amended notification of the University and government policy as per Annexure-D and E as mentioned above. But the respondent No.2 illegally did not process the petitioner's admission form with malafide intention although the opportunity for post graduate course to the government candidate over 40 years was given by the University for this year only. The petitioner having learnt that the respondent No. 2 illegally made the remarks as "over age not eligible" in his application form contacted the respondent No. 1, the Administrative Head of the Dhaka Medical College, and brought to his notice the illegality committed by the respondent No. 2 and requested him to take appropriate steps to allow the petitioner to study (MS Urology) Course at Dhaka Medical College considering that this is the last chance for him, but without any result. Being constrained, the petitioner filed application on 29-11-99 to the Vice-Chancellor, Bangabandhu Medical University, respondent No. 3, and prayed for making an arrangement for his admission into the post graduate course namely, MS (Urology) of Dhaka Medical College, but no result. The petitioner, therefore, served a legal notice demanding justice and to which the respondent Nos. 1 and 2 jointly replied to the said demand notice stating to the effect that in relaxation of age from 40 to 45 years as made is a decision of the University being an' autonomous body and they have taken their own decision, Dhaka Medical College being a purely Government institution cannot do anything without government directing by a notification.
